import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first file in `names` readable from the
    directory `notes` (relative to the current working directory).

    Names are untrusted. Only files inside `notes`, including those in
    subdirectories such as "sub/b.txt", may be read. A name that is
    missing, unreadable (a directory, bad permissions, not valid UTF-8),
    malformed (e.g. contains a NUL byte), or that would resolve to a
    location outside `notes` (via "..", an absolute path, or a symlink)
    is skipped. Returns "" when no name can be read. A readable empty
    file counts as readable and yields "".
    """
    for name in names:
        try:
            base = Path("notes").resolve()
            target = (base / name).resolve()
            if target == base or not target.is_relative_to(base):
                continue
            if not target.is_file():
                continue
            return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
            continue
    return ""


@pytest.fixture
def notes(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    d = tmp_path / "notes"
    d.mkdir()
    return d


def test_reads_simple_file(notes: Path) -> None:
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("hello", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a.txt"]) == "hello"


def test_empty_list(notes: Path) -> None:
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_missing_returns_empty(notes: Path) -> None:
    assert first_readable(["nope.txt"]) == ""


def test_skips_missing_to_first_readable(notes: Path) -> None:
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("B", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "c.txt").write_text("C", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["nope.txt", "b.txt", "c.txt"]) == "B"


def test_subdirectory_file(notes: Path) -> None:
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (notes / "sub" / "b.txt").write_text("deep", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub/b.txt"]) == "deep"


def test_directory_name_is_skipped(notes: Path) -> None:
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("A", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub", "a.txt"]) == "A"
    assert first_readable(["sub"]) == ""
    assert first_readable([".", ""]) == ""


def test_empty_file_is_readable_and_stops_search(notes: Path) -> None:
    (notes / "empty.txt").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("B", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["empty.txt", "b.txt"]) == ""


def test_undecodable_file_is_skipped(notes: Path) -> None:
    (notes / "bin.dat").write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00\x80")
    (notes / "ok.txt").write_text("ok", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["bin.dat", "ok.txt"]) == "ok"


def test_nul_byte_name_is_skipped(notes: Path) -> None:
    (notes / "ok.txt").write_text("ok", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a\x00.txt", "ok.txt"]) == "ok"
    assert first_readable(["a\x00.txt"]) == ""


def test_parent_traversal_blocked(notes: Path) -> None:
    (notes.parent / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["..//secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["../notes/../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_traversal_skipped_then_valid_name_read(notes: Path) -> None:
    (notes.parent / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("A", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt", "a.txt"]) == "A"


def test_absolute_path_outside_blocked(notes: Path) -> None:
    secret = notes.parent / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable([str(secret.resolve())]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["/etc/passwd"]) == ""


def test_sibling_directory_with_same_prefix_blocked(notes: Path) -> None:
    other = notes.parent / "notes_evil"
    other.mkdir()
    (other / "x.txt").write_text("EVIL", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../notes_evil/x.txt"]) == ""


def test_symlink_file_escaping_blocked(notes: Path) -> None:
    secret = notes.parent / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        os.symlink(secret, notes / "link.txt")
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks not supported")
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""


def test_symlink_dir_escaping_blocked(notes: Path) -> None:
    outside = notes.parent / "outside"
    outside.mkdir()
    (outside / "s.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        os.symlink(outside, notes / "d", target_is_directory=True)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks not supported")
    assert first_readable(["d/s.txt"]) == ""


def test_missing_notes_directory(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["a.txt"]) == ""
